notes.title: Crawl Halloween
notes.content:
From October 17 to November 2, the halls are strewn with bat-filled pumpkin husks, arranged as offering to the great Halloween Worms of Pestilence and Horror.

To prepare, we finally reveal the ancient rite used to POWER UP BOSSES TO NIGHTMARE DIFFICULTY:

Upon teleporting to any boss domain, you find your landing spot encircled by small stones.
Using the attack button, action each stone individually, moving clockwise from left to right.
You know the action is accepted if the button does not trigger an attack.
You will see the beast's power level increase if you have performed the ritual correctly, along with a floating follower.
Perform the ritual twice to further increase your chance to be slaughtered.

Have you grown over-confident?  Time to raise the challenge.  The beasts are hungry.

You will be consumed.

notes.title: More Multiplayer Fun from Powerhoof!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6394316/a7f597d483b944df19edc0821f140c02fd43cd24.png

Apologies for the cheeky cross promo, but we've just released our new game Regular Human Basketball!

Check it out on Steam!

If you were into playing Crawl with mates, we hope you'll love this too. It's a very different style, but we've tried to maintain the same friendship ruining experience as Crawl :D 

Regular Human Basketball is the multiplayer party-starter that has your team wrestling to control your giant mechanical death machine. Yelling orders, flipping switches, and shootin' hoops in a post-apocalyptic basketball showdown!

You can play RHBB with 2 or more players, same-screen local like crawl and online too. The more players, the more shouting and falling over!

notes.title: Play Crawl Online using Parsec
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6394316/bb98b0a34bcfef670c231d835be277164548d0cd.png

We'd always hoped to allow online play in Crawl. I spent a good chunk of time working on it, but eventually had to admit it wasn't going to be possible while maintaining what narrow grasp on sanity we still held.

But recently we noticed some people in the community playing online using something called Parsec. We've played a bunch with it ourselves now and had a great time, so we're happy to be able to give it the Official Powerhoof™ Severed Thumbs Up of Approval®!

Parsec basically lets you stream a game, and have friends watch and play along with their own controllers. Latency was my biggest worry, but it wasn't a problem when we played, certainly no worse than our dodgy indie implementation of online multiplayer would have been ;)

It's really quick and easy to get it set up, and it's also free if you host games on your own computer.  Check out our friends at Stumpt playing Crawl online with it!

How to play:
[olist]
Download the client from http://parsecgaming.com
Run it and create an account. Get your friends to do the same.
If you want to host, click "Add A Computer". In settings you can set what apps your friends can see/control too.
To join a friend who's hosting, add them using their Parsec username, and request to Co-Play.
Run the game, and friends can play just like they're sitting next to you!
[/olist]

If you have any issues with Parsec, chat to them on their discord here.

And some more news while we have your attention... 
Powerhoof Official Discord

We've just set up a discord channel, so come say hi, maybe find some people to play Crawl with!  https://discord.gg/n7t76sZ

Regular Human Basketball

Our next game now has a steam store page and is coming very soon! So check it out and get wishlisting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/661940/Regular_Human_Basketball/

notes.title: Update v0.12: Eye Bat
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/sxEn898.gif

We're here with another Crawl update to bring in the new year! If demonic bat-winged flying eyeballs are your jam we've fleshed out their monster upgrade tree. Then there's new traps, special christmas treats for your hero as well as a horde of tweaks and bug fixes.

Here's the biggest changes:

	Monsters
	
		 An eyebat bomber who fires powerful explosions
		 A cluster of three eyebat hatchlings, who work together and can heal eachother
	
	Traps
	
		 The Double Beam Trap fires in two directions, bisecting the battle with its violent searing light
		 The Homing Spike Block is magically drawn towards living flesh
		 The Dart Spout Trap fires a fast and deadly dart in front or behind
		 The Small Spike Block triggers more quickly than its larger brother
	
	 Christmas pressies for your hero
	 And more!


http://i.imgur.com/F7tfXSQ.gif

As usual, you can check out the full list of changes on the community forums, and leave us comments in there to tell us what you think!

notes.title: Update v0.11: Vengeful Spectre
notes.content:
http://imgur.com/iTzp8d1.gif

Wreak havoc on the living with oodles of new haunting opportunities for spirits.  Farm ectoplasm by rattling chains and bringing paintings to life, or possess stray barrels and furniture to throw at unsuspecting heroes!  If you're feeling fishy, we have a turret-spawning fish-like wizard, and a gargantuan fish with a horribly powerful bite to play with.

New Stuff:

	 New Monsters:
		 A gargantuan mutated fish with a mighty chomp and a deceptively agile roll
		 Magic wielding monks hide their fishlike bodies beneath hooded robes, hurling water spells and summoning beastly fish turrets
	 New Object Haunting System:
		 Ghosts can farm ectoplasm by animating props around the dungeon
		 Many props can be levitated and thrown as makeshift traps
	 New Usable Objects:
		 Paintings, mirrors, shackles, bleeding grates and haunted stocks for ghosts to animate
		 Trees can now be drained by heroes to gain Vitality
		 Heroes can find bonfires, to rest and regain health
	 Mimics:  Some of our chests can now be inhabited to turn them into vicious monsters
	 Halloween Pumpkins! Don't try to eat them, I'm pretty sure they're full of bats
	 Loads of tweaks and bug fixes Yaaay!


http://imgur.com/DlItYxT.gif

Check out the full list of changes on the community forums!

notes.title: Crawl Minor Update v0.01.02
notes.content:
Just a minor update to add some more controller support and fix a few issues. Gameplay features, new content and balancing are still to come in the first major update next month!

Here's the changelist -

Features:
Steam Cloud support: You no longer have to unlock everything again on each machine you play on!
	NB: The first machine you play on with the update will sync it's existing progress to steam cloud.  After that other machines you play on will take the progress that's in the cloud. (So play on the machine with the most progress first!)
Added direction control calibration (up/down/left/right). You should be able calibrate and use "retro" controllers and arcade sticks now.
Keyboard can now be set up to have multiple players. Choose Keyboard Setup in the options menu to set your keys.
You can now use the mouse to navigate the front menus.

Fixes:
Mouse controls no longer break after finishing a game using the mouse.
Fixed single controller being able to join and control multiple players. (eg: DualShock4 on Linux)
Fixed discounted store items marked as "can't afford" incorrectly when player had exact amount of gold.
Safe zone values no longer load incorrectly and mess up the GUI on Linux.
Corrected spelling of vampiric ring.
Hero arrows no longer hit the wall behind when fired.
Bot ghosts no longer hover over pentagram without using it.
Bots no longer continuously try and shoot chests/crystals with bow when there's a wall in the way.

Next up I'll be working on some of the balance issues we've been discussing on the community forums. Barney's been working on some new monsters, and he's heading off to the US for PAX Prime this week. We're not showing Crawl off on the PAX show floor, but if you're in Seattle you can wander around the corner to the free Seattle Indies Expo and play there. Barney will be hanging around so try and hunt him down for a game!
